subject: BrightWorks launch: temporary rate window + traffic forecast request
body:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightWorks launch: temporary rate window + traffic forecast request

Hi team,

BrightWorks is going live with their conversational recommendation feature on 2026-11-02 (internal launch to 10% of users, then ramp). Customer asked for a temporary higher ingress window for the first 72 hours to avoid throttles while they validate model outputs. They provided tentative traffic shapes (see attachment).

Asks: 
- Product: confirm whether we can support a temporary rate window (72h) for an account-level uplift and what product guards are required. Are there any model-level constraints for prefix caching during ramp?
- Infra/Capacity (David): can we commit to +3x baseline for 72h starting 2026-11-02 00:00 UTC? If not, what's the max we can guarantee and what lead time is needed?
- Sales/CS (Marissa/Priya): finalize the exact uplift numbers and the acceptance criteria for rollback (error rates, token latency thresholds).

I'm looping in Samira (BrightWorks) in the next message to collect precise hourly forecasts. Attaching a filled quota request form and their forecast spreadsheet for review.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Sales Partner, Redwood Inference
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightworks.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWorks launch: temporary rate window + traffic forecast request

Thanks Hannah — quick notes from my side: 
- Customer narrative: they will route traffic from an A/B experiment; expected 30k calls/hr at peak for the 10% cohort, average token length ~120. They expect that to double after the second day if metrics look good.
- Acceptance criteria: if 5xx > 1% for 30m or median p95 latency > 800ms we trigger an automatic rollback to standard quota.
- Commercial: we're proposing a 72-hour temporary uplift with a usage cap; will put credits on the table for exceeding baseline by >2x.

Samira — can you add the hourly breakdown and confirm timezone for the go-live? We need that to lock routing windows.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: bw_quota_request_form.pdf

---

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightworks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: BrightWorks EngOps <engops@brightworks.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWorks launch: temporary rate window + traffic forecast request

Hi Marissa/Hannah — thanks for the quick turnaround. Hourly forecast attached (launch-ingress-projections.xlsx). Key points: 
- Peak period we expect 30k calls/hr between 14:00–18:00 UTC on day 1 (2026-11-02).
- Day 2 conservative peak 45k calls/hr if engagement metrics are positive.
- Token profile: median 110, 90th 210.
- We absolutely need a temporary increase to avoid throttling during the 14:00–20:00 UTC window on day 1.

Questions for ops/product: is there a preferred way to route this traffic so it hits dedicated nodes with warming? Would a canary split (10% to warmed pool) work best?

Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, BrightWorks
Attachment: launch-ingress-projections.xlsx

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@brightworks.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 13:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightWorks launch: temporary rate window + traffic forecast request

Thanks — consolidated ask and next steps below.

Summary of asks: 
- Temporary uplift: 72h window starting 2026-11-02 00:00 UTC, with an initial 3x baseline for first 24h and ability to scale to 4x if observed tail latency and error rates remain within thresholds.
- Hourly schedule: customer-provided peaks 14:00–18:00 UTC day 1 and potential day-2 spike to 45k/hr.
- Guardrails: auto-rollback on 5xx > 1% for 30m or p95 latency > 800ms; routing fallback to standard variant if detected.
- Routing recommendation: use warmed dedicated pool + canary split (10% traffic to warmed nodes for the first 2h) then move 100% to warmed pool for peak windows. This minimizes cold start effects while limiting exposure.

Action items (owners):
- David Kim (Infra): validate capacity for 3x baseline now and confirm if we can provision an extra warmed pool for the peak windows. Please reply with concrete provisioning steps and lead time.
- Priya Natarajan (Product): confirm if product-side cache warming and prefix-KV priming steps are needed; provide any config flags required on the account.
- Marissa Cole (Sales): finalize the approval email to Samira with the commercial terms for the temporary uplift (credits/overage caps).
- Hannah Schmitt (Sales Ops): file the quota uplift ticket once David confirms capacity. Use deal ID BW-1429-P1 in the ticket.

I'll hold off on making infra changes until David confirms. If we cannot provision dedicated warmed nodes, we will need a more conservative uplift and tighter time windows.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product — Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
